thesis: The podcast argues that a nuclear energy comeback is necessary because the world has a non-reversible need for clean, reliable baseload power to support growing energy consumption. It highlights that while nuclear construction slowed due to high costs and public misconceptions, new reactor designs and government initiatives now offer a safer, more resilient alternative to volatile fuel sources like natural gas.
